Arial Beel

A broad seasonal wetland that changes from open monsoon water to cultivated dry-season ground.

Location
Sreenagar, Munshiganj
How to get there
Use the Sreenagar approach. The pin marks the wetland area. Ask locally for an accessible landing or public field approach.
Access and opening hours
Routes and boat availability change with water levels. Confirm a suitable landing before making a monsoon trip.
Dhaka Tribune · Chasing twilight at Arial Beel

Published sources reviewed 20 November 2026.

Seasonal wetland

About this place

Between the Padma and Dhaleshwari, the beel fills during the rains and supports fishing and aquatic life. As floodwaters recede, cultivation returns to parts of the basin. Its wet and dry seasons give very different impressions of the same place.

The map pin identifies the wetland area. Ask locally for the appropriate entry point and check conditions before arranging a boat.
